title: ‘Spotlight’ on 2016 Oscar Nominees
main_content:
The Oscar nominations were announced in Beverly Hills, California.​

“The Revenant” and “The Martian” are among the eight nominated for best motion picture. The others include “Mad Max: Fury Road”, and “Bridge of Spies”.

Leonardo DiCaprio, star of “The Revenant,” and “The Martian” lead Matt Damon will compete for the best actor Oscar.

Best actress nominees include Cate Blanchett for “Carol", and Jennifer Lawrence for “Joy.” Lawrence plays the real inventor and successful businesswoman Joy Mangano.

Nominees for best director include George Miller for “Mad Max: Fury Road,” Alejandro Inarritu for “The Revenant,” and Tom McCarthy for “Spotlight.”

This year’s foreign language nominees include the Arabic-language “Theeb” from Jordan.

The Oscars are the top award in the American movie industry.
